handoff_summary: Proceed to a review-only v0.3 Discovery Layer design that defines discovery patterns and boundaries before schema or verifier implementation.
required_context: QIF remains the representation layer for discovered quality intents.
Discovery Layer remains the mechanism for finding candidate quality intents.
Checklist-driven quality coverage is an anti-pattern.
Discovery coverage must measure exploration breadth, not checklist completion.
open_questions: Which Discovery Patterns should be canonical in v0.3 versus experimental?
What confidence model is sufficient for candidate Quality Intents before expert validation?
Should v0.3 include schemas for Discovery Patterns or remain design-only first?
